vulnerabilities.description: An issue was discovered in libmodbus before 3.0.7 and 3.1.x before 3.1.5. There is an out-of-bounds read for the MODBUS_FC_WRITE_MULTIPLE_COILS case, aka VD-1302.

analysis.detail: Identified by SBOM component matching. VEX adjudication (exploitability in this ICS deployment) not yet performed.

vulnerabilities.description: An issue was discovered in libmodbus before 3.0.7 and 3.1.x before 3.1.5. There is an out-of-bounds read for the MODBUS_FC_WRITE_MULTIPLE_REGISTERS case, aka VD-1301.

analysis.detail: Identified by SBOM component matching. VEX adjudication (exploitability in this ICS deployment) not yet performed.

vulnerabilities.description: BusyBox through 1.35.0 allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code if netstat is used to print a DNS PTR record's value to a VT compatible terminal. Alternatively, the attacker could choose to change the terminal's colors.

analysis.detail: Identified by SBOM component matching. VEX adjudication (exploitability in this ICS deployment) not yet performed.

vulnerabilities.description: Net-SNMP through 5.8 has Improper Privilege Management because SNMP WRITE access to the EXTEND MIB provides the ability to run arbitrary commands as root.

analysis.detail: Identified by SBOM component matching. VEX adjudication (exploitability in this ICS deployment) not yet performed.

vulnerabilities.description: fs/seq_file.c in the Linux kernel 3.16 through 5.13.x before 5.13.4 does not properly restrict seq buffer allocations, leading to an integer overflow, an Out-of-bounds Write, and escalation to root by an unprivileged user, aka CID-8cae8cd89f05.

analysis.detail: Identified by SBOM component matching. VEX adjudication (exploitability in this ICS deployment) not yet performed.

vulnerabilities.description: A flaw was found in the way the "flags" member of the new pipe buffer structure was lacking proper initialization in copy_page_to_iter_pipe and push_pipe functions in the Linux kernel and could thus contain stale values. An unprivileged local user could use this flaw to write to pages in the page cache backed by read only files and as such escalate their privileges on the system.

analysis.detail: Identified by SBOM component matching. VEX adjudication (exploitability in this ICS deployment) not yet performed.

vulnerabilities.description: In versions 1.6 to 2.0.11 of Eclipse Mosquitto, an MQTT v5 client connecting with a large number of user-property properties could cause excessive CPU usage, leading to a loss of performance and possible denial of service.
